summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by MindWalk Holdings Corp. (NASDAQ: HYFT), a foreign private issuer, announcing the launch of ReefIQ, a new software product for AI drug discovery. The filing is a press release about a commercial product launch and contains no information about an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or abrupt management change. It is a routine current report of business operations and does not qualify as a special situation.
